name: Agricultural and veterinary chemicals
what: Use only registered agricultural and veterinary chemicals and follow each state's rules on how they may be used, by whom, and when off-label use is allowed.

layers.who: Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicines Authority (product registration)
State agriculture or environment agency (control of use)
State agriculture or environment agency (control of use)

basis.source: Administrative and support services industry (industry information)
basis.quote: States and territories regulate the use of agricultural chemical products , such as pesticides.
Registration for the manufacturing, transport, trade or supply of pesticides and veterinary medicines

issues.what: Each state sets its own rules for using farm and veterinary chemicals after sale, including which 'off-label' uses are allowed, so the same product can be used differently across a border.

evidence.quote: agvet chemicals - differences between control-of-use regimes (such as differences in permitted 'off-label' uses) lead to confusion for users and add to compliance costs (and the variation is not always justified on regional factors)
